name: Admiralo Island Witches Club
source:
Join the after school witches club!

Admiralo Island Witches Club is a women-positive, narrative-driven game with a focus on friendship, mystery and adventure.  Attend classes, explore the island and befriend nature spirits with the other girls of the witches club.

[From [url=https://cloverfirefly.itch.io/admiralo-island-witches-club-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入课后女巫社！

《阿德米拉洛岛女巫社》是一款支持女性、以叙事为核心的游戏，主题是友谊、神秘与冒险。与女巫社的其他女孩一起上课、探索岛屿，并和自然精灵成为朋友。

[来源：[url=https://cloverfirefly.itch.io/admiralo-island-witches-club-demo]itch.io[/url]]
